description: An upper body pressing exercise using a chair or bench to build tricep strength and shoulder extension stability.
setup: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair or bench, place hands next to hips with fingers gripping the forward edge, and step feet forward.
steps: Slide hips off the bench surface while keeping your chest open and torso upright.
Lower your body by bending at the elbows until upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press firmly down through your palms to return to full arm extension.
cues: Keep hips close to the bench as you descend
Drive through the heels of your hands to lock out elbows

mistakes.mistake: Drifting hips too far away from the bench
mistakes.fix: Keep your back brushing lightly against the edge of the seat to protect anterior shoulders

mistakes.mistake: Shoulders rolling forward into rounding posture
mistakes.fix: Pin shoulder blades down and back, maintaining proud chest throughout

rep_standard: Elbows reach at least 90 degrees at bottom, complete elbow extension at top
